purpose: resolve and revalidate frozen P5 approvers without CUT reading PROJ or SYSTEM tables
trustedTenant: tenantId must equal TenantContextHolder.getRequiredTenantId before Owner calls

ProjectCutoverServiceManagerFactApi.deliveryUnit: F-CUT-005 PROJ physical-owner support Task; no separate Feature or table; Provider may reuse the existing ProjectParticipant aggregate and locking rules

inspectCurrent.output: FOUND|NOT_UNIQUE; FOUND carries exactly one current primary SERVICE_MANAGER_L1 or SERVICE_MANAGER_L2 user, projectVersion, participantFactVersion and roleCode

lockAndRevalidate.output: VALID|STALE; STALE carries current FOUND or NOT_UNIQUE result

inspectCandidates.output: CANDIDATES carrying every enabled member as adminUserId, roleGroupId, roleMembershipVersion and userStatusVersion, sorted by adminUserId ascending with unique adminUserId; empty is valid; partial or duplicate output is OWNER_DATA_CORRUPTED

lockAndRevalidate.locking: SYSTEM locks the role group then every previously/currently relevant membership and user-status fact in adminUserId order; CUT separately locks ProjectScope ACTION_VIEW facts in the same user order
lockAndRevalidate.output: VALID only when the complete current enabled candidate set is identical to the frozen SYSTEM set; STALE carries the complete current CANDIDATES fact for CUT to recompute the project-visible intersection after its separate ProjectScope locks

lockExplicitCandidate.output: ELIGIBLE carrying roleGroupId, roleMembershipVersion and userStatusVersion | INELIGIBLE

CutoverApprovalRoleCandidateFactApi.projectScopeComposition: CUT must first inspect the complete SYSTEM candidate set, then inspect ProjectScopeApi ACTION_VIEW for every candidate, and choose a subject only when the intersection contains exactly one user. Zero or multiple intersected users is NOT_UNIQUE. Global multiplicity alone does not reject a route and global role membership alone never grants project approval. The frozen candidate snapshot contains the complete SYSTEM member identities/versions, every inspected ProjectScope result/treeVersion and the single intersected subject or explicit NOT_UNIQUE. Transactional revalidation locks the same complete facts and recomputes the intersection; no pre-scope arbitrary user selection is allowed

routeMapping.INITIATOR: trusted current user from F-CUT-004 submit transaction plus ProjectScopeApi ACTION_EDIT; freeze userId, projectId, ACTION_EDIT and treeVersion from one locked fact before creating the node

reassignmentRules.INITIATOR: explicit target must pass ProjectScopeApi ACTION_EDIT for the same project; nodeCode and original initiator history remain unchanged
reassignmentRules.SERVICE_MANAGER: explicit target must equal the current unique FOUND user from ProjectCutoverServiceManagerFactApi and its fact is locked again
reassignmentRules.SECOND_LINE_RND: explicit target must be ELIGIBLE from CutoverApprovalRoleCandidateFactApi.lockExplicitCandidate and pass ProjectScopeApi ACTION_VIEW

initiatorMachineContract.processingRevalidation: the currentApproverUserId, whether original or reassigned, must lock ProjectScopeApi ACTION_EDIT for the same project and frozen treeVersion before approve/reject; a changed treeVersion is STALE, explicit scope denial is APPROVER_UNAVAILABLE, and Provider failure remains PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
initiatorMachineContract.visibility: the original initiator may view progress only while current ProjectScopeApi ACTION_VIEW is valid; reassignment changes processing identity only and never overwrites original initiator history

notUniqueRule: PROJ service-manager zero/multiple result, or SYSTEM complete-candidate-set intersect ProjectScope ACTION_VIEW producing zero/multiple users, creates/retains the approval instance in PENDING with holdReason=ROUTE_CANDIDATE_NOT_UNIQUE and no executable todo for that node; SYSTEM global multiplicity is never evaluated before the project-scope intersection and no arbitrary candidate is selected
controlledSubstituteBoundary: src/test may deterministically return valid candidates and watermarks; no production Fake, fallback, direct table read or Yudao foundation modification is authorized
